entities.name: SOD3 R213G (rs1799895)
observations: R213G reduces extracellular-matrix and vascular binding; knock-in mice show redistribution from lung and vascular tissue toward plasma and bronchoalveolar fluid despite unchanged enzyme activity.

Cardiopulmonary associations are compartment- and outcome-dependent: airway/allergic phenotypes may be reduced, while hypoxic pulmonary hypertension and some cardiovascular risks may increase; human associations remain heterogeneous.

entities.name: R213G redistribution
observations: SOD3 R213G weakens extracellular-matrix and vascular binding and shifts EC-SOD from lung/vascular tissue toward plasma and bronchoalveolar fluid in experimental models.

entities.name: R213G disease risk
observations: R213G distribution provides a plausible mechanism for divergent cardiopulmonary effects, but human disease associations are heterogeneous and do not establish a uniform risk increase.

entities.name: SOD3 Ala40Thr
observations: Ala40Thr (also called Ala38Thr in alternate numbering) is not established to alter SOD3 tissue binding or extracellular distribution; cardiopulmonary risk evidence is sparse and indirect.
